children.text: The advertisement begins with Sydney Sweeney introducing the main idea behind the brand Novig. She states the slogan, “Novig is just sports” to emphasize that the platform is specifically focused on sports trading and gambling. This establishes the purpose of the advertisement almost immediately, so the audience can understand what Novig is at the start of the video. Sweeney also serves as a significant part of the advertisement’s ethos, since she is a well-known celebrity and influencer whose presence is capable of attracting attention and engagement to a relatively unfamiliar brand. Instead of introducing Novig through a traditional spokesperson or commercial, the company uses Sweeney’s recognizable personality to make the message more memorable and entertaining for viewers. This is particularly effective for an Instagram audience because she is very well-known on that platform, and the advertisement is immediately reaching her 25.9 million followers by being posted on her account.

Another important rhetorical choice occurs when the advertisement begins with Sydney Sweeney surrounded by, wearing, and holding recognizable sporting equipment and gear while appearing practically naked. The setting immediately connects her to the subject Novig wants its audience to associate with the company, and the fact that she seems to have nothing on her body besides two footballs covering her chest adds a shock value to the advertisement. This is an example of visual rhetoric because the advertisement does not rely only on Sweeney explaining what the company does but makes the advertisement unusual and stand out. Rather than showing a traditional athlete playing a game and wearing a uniform, Novig places a celebrity “it girl” in exaggerated, sexy sports related situations while her being almost completely nude. This choice is designed to grab the audience’s attention and ragebait them for more engagement. The intended audience is people interested in sports betting and trading. This is a predominately male demographic, which is why the advertisement is targeted towards men. Combining recognizable sports imagery with Sydney Sweeney’s celebrity status and sex appeal allows Novig to attract men to using their platform.
